title: Wax golems
content:
A wax golem that steals a person's memory and identity then takes their place attacked [[Viceroy Orhan]]. The golem is lurking in one of Jahur's abandoned palaces, plotting its next move. Orhan's amnesia will persist until the golem is slain.

[[Lady Naideen]] created a golem of giant beeswax and animated it using a [[orange gems|scaled, orange stone]] ([[17.11]]).

Wax golems in the Mind Chambers of the Infidel ([[27.12]]) are life-like mannikins that each represents a facet of the Infidel's personality, and that can rebuild themselves after almost any indignity.
